concerns.text: Naming conflict for the atomic size descriptor: `processed_alloys.schema.yaml` uses `atomic_size_difference`, while `features.schema.yaml` and `dataset.schema.yaml` use `atomic_size_mismatch`. This will cause `validate_schemas.py` to fail.
The entity `model_output.json` is required by the plan (Phase 5.2) and defined in `contracts/model_output.schema.yaml`, but is missing from the Entity Definitions in `data-model.md`.
